hyperedges.label: Single Dataset Across Loading Validation and Tests

nodes.label: Bangladesh Services Abbreviation Converter Dataset
nodes.rationale: Schema 1.1.0 dataset is the single source of truth, avoiding duplicated or hard-coded dictionary entries.

nodes.label: Cursor-based Forward Conversion
nodes.rationale: Longest complete phrase wins; generated output is never rescanned, preventing replacement cascading and preserving untouched source formatting.

nodes.label: Protected Spans
nodes.rationale: URLs, email addresses, file paths, decimals, date/time groups and existing authorized abbreviations are protected.

nodes.label: Case-exact Reverse Conversion
nodes.rationale: Case-exact boundary-aware matching avoids interpreting ordinary lower-case prose as national or military abbreviations.

nodes.label: Reverse Expansion Ambiguity Review
nodes.rationale: Multiple meanings remain unchanged for user review; Annex B choices use meanings rather than combined printed full_form.

nodes.label: Startup Dataset Validation
nodes.rationale: Blocking diagnostics disable conversion, while medium-confidence records remain usable with verification indicators and warnings.

nodes.label: Local Text Processing
nodes.rationale: Conversion text is processed locally and not uploaded; matching indexes and conversion work stay in the browser.

nodes.label: Production Service Worker
nodes.rationale: Registered only in production; an initial online production visit caches application resources and the dataset for offline use.

nodes.label: Source-manual Review
nodes.rationale: The application assists writing and does not replace source-manual review, particularly for uncertain records and ambiguous reverse abbreviations.

nodes.label: Shared Next.js Platform Delivery
nodes.rationale: One codebase serves web, Windows, Android and iOS; wrappers load the deployed URL and do not modify src.

nodes.label: Deployed Application Server
nodes.rationale: Server serves the app and collects issue reports; conversion still runs on-device in the browser or web view.

nodes.label: Fully Offline Static Export
nodes.rationale: No-server installers require static export, which cannot support the issue-report API without a cloud endpoint.

nodes.label: Capacitor Web Placeholder
nodes.rationale: Placeholder only: native shells load the deployed web app URL configured in capacitor.config.json server.url.
